items.question: What is FunDAO?
items.answer: FunDAO is the world's first decentralized value-added platform with 'FunDAO' as its core governance model, built on PVP Fun underlying platform, built on BNB Smart Chain (BSC). Through innovative quadruple mechanism of 'Daily Deflation + Smart Circuit Breaker + Automatic Revenue Distribution + Liquidity Buffer Pool', it solves three core DeFi pain points: unsustainable deflation, inability to lock in retail investor profits, and lack of trust in project teams.

items.question: What are FunDAO's four mechanisms?
items.answer: Four mechanisms work in synergy: ① Daily deflation 2.5% (50% burn + 50% distribution) continuously reduces supply; ② Smart circuit breaker three-tier protection (5%/10%/20%) prevents crashes; ③ Automatic revenue distribution (Direct 15% + Community incentive 35% + Weekly dividend 15%) locks in profits; ④ Liquidity buffer pool (BNB-denominated) provides bottom support. Four mechanisms interlock to form sustainable value growth cycle.

items.question: How to participate in FunDAO?
items.answer: Start with just 0.1 BNB (about $60), accessible DeFi for everyone. After joining, enjoy direct referral reward 15% (instant), community contribution incentive 35% (35% of referred person's revenue), weekly dividend 15% (weighted distribution, weekly settlement). All rules verifiable on-chain, transparent and fair.

items.question: How does circuit breaker protect investors?
items.answer: Three-tier circuit breaker protection: >5% drop triggers 50% breaker (receive only 500k), >10% triggers 70% (receive only 300k), >20% triggers 90% (receive only 100k). After triggering, all FUN sold that day is burned, unclaimed BNB flows back to pool. Effectively prevents crashes and project team misconduct, protecting all participants' interests.

items.question: How does FunDAO ensure security?
items.answer: Adopts 'Six-No' security architecture: no project team, no private sale, no reserve, no hidden allocation, no backdoors, permissions discarded. All smart contract code fully open-source, management permissions permanently discarded after deployment: cannot modify rules, cannot mint, cannot pause, cannot transfer funds. Five core modules (Trading Engine, Distribution Engine, Deflation Engine, Circuit Breaker, Liquidity Buffer Pool) all verifiable on-chain.

items.question: Which institutional investors support FunDAO?
items.answer: Backed by 13 top global crypto investment institutions: Dragonfly, Animoca Brands, OKX Ventures, Spartan Group, Bitscale Capital, 6th Man Ventures, IVC, Mechanism Capital, Morningstar Ventures, W3GG, Xinyuan Capital, Red Building Capital, Yolo Investments. Ecosystem partners include Binance (spot/futures deep cooperation), Hyperliquid (AI smart trading), FuFuture (decentralized contract exchange).

rewards.title: Revenue System
rewards.content: FunDAO builds a multi-dimensional, multi-level revenue system composed of three pillars: referral contribution rewards, community contribution incentives, and weekly dividends. Start with just 0.1 BNB (about $60), accessible DeFi for everyone.

pillars.name: Referral Contribution Reward 15%
pillars.description: Directly refer new participants, referrers receive 15% of the referred person's participation amount as referral contribution reward. Instant到账, only counts direct referrals (no multi-level distribution), 15% high ratio industry-leading.
pillars.example: A refers B, B participates with 1,000 U → A receives 150 U, instant到账

pillars.name: Community Contribution Incentive 35%
pillars.description: Referrers receive 35% of the dynamic revenue earned by referred persons in the system. Share growth dividends, incentivize high-quality referrals, build social network effects.
pillars.example: A refers B, B earns 1 million revenue → A receives 350,000

pillars.name: Weekly Dividend 15% (Weighted Distribution)
pillars.description: 15% of total weekly performance is extracted as weekly dividend pool, distributed by weighted ratio. Higher performance means higher weight, settled weekly, fair and transparent.
pillars.example: Personal weekly dividend = Weekly dividend pool × (Personal performance weight / Total network performance weight)
